title: Omaplan plan
description: Snapshot of the plan (plan.json), written atomically by omaplan after every change. See docs/export.md for the semantics and web/MARKUP.md for the markup contract.

version.description: Format version; 2 is this edition (English keys)

exported.description: ISO 8601 with offset, the time of the export

timezone.description: IANA name of the local time zone, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen

language.description: BCP 47 code of the app's user interface language, e.g. en or da

theme.description: Optional theme colours from the Omarchy theme, so the read-only edition follows it. Hex #RRGGBB, and Omarchy's font family.

accent_text.description: The accent as a text colour, readable on bg

font.description: Omarchy's font family (fontconfig's monospace); the page falls back to monospace

start.description: Optional. ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), local time without offset. null or absent = not scheduled (the group No date)

duration_min.description: Duration in minutes; absent when the task is all-day or only has a deadline

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date or date and time, local time without offset; separate from start

source.description: UUID of the capture it came from, or null when created directly
